<!-- ## Pre-class prep -->

<!-- No pre-class prep before our first day of class! -->

Today you will run a complete data science workflow from a raw file on the internet
to a finished figure, before you know how any single piece works. The morning gives you
just enough Python to read the code. The afternoon plays the whole game.

## End-of-day practice

Your last task today is to run the whole workflow again on your own, changing a few things
as you go. You are not expected to understand every line yet. Reading working code and
modifying it deliberately is the skill for today.

- [{{< fa pencil title="A pencil" >}} **Day 1 Practice:** Rerun the Whole Game](eod-practice/eod-day1-2026.qmd)
